messages.author: Hana Kobayashi
messages.text: Kickoff for the Q4 holiday creative brief. Theme: 'Winter Court'. Please drop requests for formats, hooks and markets in the thread by Aug 29.

replies.author: Priya Raman
replies.text: Meta: 4:5 and 9:16 statics plus 15s video. TikTok: at least 6 UGC pieces, last year's holiday creatives fatigued in ~10 days.

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Unity: playables only, we're likely pausing the video retarget campaign. AppLovin: 30s video + playable.

replies.author: Marisol Okafor
replies.text: Love the theme. Please keep the dice front and centre, brand tracking says people remember the dice, not the castle.
